Scenario: Normal release: all gates and closure evidence satisfied
Fault Action: No injection; three-stage health checks, artifact digest, and signal dispositions all normal
B1 Steps: Real attestation issued and verified successfully
Minimum Evidence: Complete CI logs, artifact digest, upstream events, and B2 decision

Fault Action: Scan gate WAIVED; policy permits, approver valid, approval time before cutoff
B0 Steps: Record approval and gate state per the real waiver policy; do not fabricate tool-native waivers
B1 Steps: Provenance attestation verified as for a normal artifact
Minimum Evidence: Original policy and approval events, gate states, B2 decision

Fault Action: Generate a Finding after cutoff, bind the correct Requirement, target release verified
B0 Steps: Existing release gates run as usual (no claim of native Finding linkage)
B1 Steps: Verify provenance of the target artifact for real
Minimum Evidence: Finding/Requirement/Target time series, source snapshot hashes

Fault Action: Remove the effective Disposition of SIG-002 while keeping the independent raw inventory
B0 Steps: Real gates run faithfully; the defect is injected only at the evidence disposition layer
B1 Steps: Real attestation verification; do not assume it checks dispositions
Minimum Evidence: Difference between raw and disposition sets, failure codes

Scenario: Two effective dispositions for one identity
Fault Action: Add a second effective Disposition for SIG-002
B0 Steps: Real tests pass or judge per configuration
B1 Steps: Real provenance attestation verified as usual
Minimum Evidence: Both original Dispositions, timing and uniqueness failure codes

Fault Action: Mark the SIG-002 disposition UNRESOLVED with the corresponding Candidate status OPEN
B0 Steps: Gates actually run; do not fake standard-gate judgments on business pending items

Fault Action: Apply AUTHORIZED_EXCLUDED to SIG-002 where the actor lacks policy permission
B0 Steps: Keep real policies and approval roles

Fault Action: Modify the raw payload of SIG-002 without updating its payload_sha256
B0 Steps: Real tests and artifact digest checks run as usual
B1 Steps: Verify the real artifact; do not assume artifact provenance can verify business signal payloads
Minimum Evidence: Original payload and digest, digest-verification failure code

Fault Action: Place occurrence/receipt time of SIG-002 after the source release cutoff
B0 Steps: B0 runs as usual; keep gate times and injection times

Fault Action: Point the Finding's creates relation to a different Finding ID while keeping the target seemingly satisfied
B0 Steps: B0 runs per the configured process
Minimum Evidence: source finding and creates_requirement wrong edge, failure_code

Scenario: Target release validation failed or incomplete
Fault Action: Finding successor relation valid, target due, but the real target validation status is FAIL
B0 Steps: B0 runs as usual for the source release; a target release must run real tests
B1 Steps: Record the real attestation result for the target artifact
Minimum Evidence: target due, target validation result, audit failure codes

Scenario: Later attempt to rewrite a historical frozen snapshot
Fault Action: Keep the frozen payload/hash, modify the observed/current snapshot payload
B0 Steps: Preserve the original cutoff decision of the source release and the later update facts
B1 Steps: Do not overstate attestation capability as historical snapshot audit
Minimum Evidence: original frozen hash, later observed payload hash, historical result retention value

Scenario: Raw signal population boundary not independently confirmable
Fault Action: Remove collector completeness and query-scope attestations (keep extracted signals)
B0 Steps: Real gates run normally; record which class of raw evidence is missing
Minimum Evidence: List of missing materials with NFI marker; must not claim data omission is proven

Scenario: Source release attribution of a Finding unresolved
Fault Action: Keep the Finding trigger facts, set source_release_id to null; must not empty the obligation set
Minimum Evidence: finding observed facts, source attribution NFI, obligations that did not disappear

Scenario: Standard gates must detect: real unit test failure
Fault Action: Set INJECT_B01=1 to make an actual unittest case fail; record the gate FAIL
B0 Steps: Actually execute the failing test, store the original exit code and error
B1 Steps: Keep the B0 test failure; must not mask it with attestation
Minimum Evidence: Original unittest failure stdout and workflow failure, B2 gate failure codes

Scenario: Standard existing provenance tool must detect: artifact substitution after signing
Fault Action: After actions/attest signing, modify the pyz bytes and run gh attestation verify
B0 Steps: The B0 artifact SHA pin must also actually verify; it may detect this as well
B1 Steps: Real gh attestation verify must reject the modified artifact
Minimum Evidence: Pre/post-signing artifact SHAs, gh CLI exit and attestation bundle

Scenario: ZHFB R2: unresolved signals, failed gates, and cutoff
Fault Action: No controlled injection: only receive second-round raw project records and rebuild after source acceptance
B0 Steps: Re-verify the source system's real gate execution records; do not claim green runs were misses
B1 Steps: Report real results only if the tool was actually deployed; otherwise N/A
Minimum Evidence: Real source record IDs, extraction rules, native/curated split, independent Oracle

Scenario: ZHFB R3: 11:00 cutoff vs 11:10 post-release smoke
Fault Action: No controlled injection: re-verify historical visibility and gate policy
B0 Steps: Re-verify whether the 11:10 smoke was admitted by gates rather than judged a violation
B1 Steps: Record N/A where the original system deployed no attestation tooling
Minimum Evidence: cutoff policy, source gate records, snapshot times, independent conclusions

Scenario: ZHFB R4: 6/6 dispositions yet the snapshot stays frozen
Fault Action: No controlled injection: first obtain why it stayed frozen and the source of right-censoring
B0 Steps: Reconstruct all actual gates and release decisions
B1 Steps: Mark N/A per actual tool deployment
Minimum Evidence: Original freeze reason, state history, right-censoring explanation, raw records
